agent_rules: List existing docs first; take the next free ID; never reuse or renumber IDs.
Check companies by name before adding one; set jobs.company to the exact existing company name.
New jobs: current_stage 'Lead', highest_stage 'None'. Never set application or interview fields; the user does that.
Dates as YYYY-MM-DD. Numbers (pay_low, pay_high, hiring_difficulty, skill_match) as numbers.
listing_evidence must be one of: Employer page read | Indexed lead - verify | Historical lead - recheck | Conflicting status - verify | Verified live.
Set updated_by to your agent name and updated_at to an ISO timestamp.
When updating an existing doc, use update (merge) and never blank out fields the user filled in.
Do not invent pay, eligibility or benefits; leave unknown fields out.

People: only record names and titles found on public professional sources (company pages, press, job posts); put the source in source_url. No personal contact details, home locations, or private social accounts.
Mark knowledge-based company notes 'From general knowledge - verify'; only claim 'Verified' when you retrieved a source this session.
fit_score/stability_score/remote_likelihood are model estimates from the page's screening; replace remote_likelihood and maine_remote with verified facts when you research a company.

Bulk additions (more than ~10 companies) go to the imports collection as one doc {collection:'companies', status:'pending', label, added_by, rows:[...]}; the user adds them from the page, which skips duplicates and assigns IDs.
candidate_constraints: Lives in Columbia, Maine: roles must be fully remote and open to Maine residents unless the user says otherwise. Senior software test / SDET / QA leadership, ~15 yrs, C#/.NET, Python, mobile + API automation, CI/CD, FDA-regulated device testing, RFID/BLE location tech.
purpose: Evan Ringo's job search tracker. Collections: jobs, companies, people, activity, materials. One document per row; document id = the row's ID field. Companies are tracked whether or not they have openings; people are managers/leaders worth approaching directly.
